request: Auto-fix expired Hermes profile Codex OAuth tokens in HivemindOS

entries.note: Adapted the accepted rejected-refresh self-heal: require a current access+refresh pair from Codex CLI, persist via Hermes locked auth writer, and re-resolve before chat.
Adapted the pool health contract by accepting only a non-expiring selected runtime access token and recovering an expired pool fallback before the model request.
Adapted the upstream temporary HERMES_HOME/CODEX_HOME auth-store fixtures to prove expired recovery, healthy no-op behavior, and unavailable fallback against the installed Hermes package.
Reused the established scoped Hermes Python bridge pattern with HERMES_HOME, PYTHONPATH, bounded execution, and JSON-only output.
Extended the existing per-profile pre-launch Hermes bridge at both streaming and non-streaming chat entry points after fleet permission checks.
